_about: John Witherspoon (1723-1794), minister of Beith and Paisley, then President of the College of New Jersey (Princeton) and a signer of the Declaration of Independence: The Works of John Witherspoon, containing essays, sermons and lectures (Edinburgh: Ogle & Aikman, 1804-1805, 9 vols). Volume numbers read off each title page. His Ecclesiastical Characteristics, the satire on the Moderates, is among the essays. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
